sentences.zh: 使其將孫待封、張法雷擊之，景山眾潰，與延恩奔壽州。

translations.literal: He ordered his generals Sun Daifeng and Zhang Falei to strike them; Jingshan's host collapsed, and with Yan'en he fled to Shou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent his generals Sun Daifeng and Zhang Falei to attack. Jingshan's army broke and fled, and he and Yan'en ran to Shou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 展引兵入廣陵，遣其將屈突孝標將兵三千徇濠、楚，王□恆將兵四千略淮西。

translations.literal: Zhan led troops into Guangling, sent his general Quetu Xiaobiao to lead three thousand troops to subdue Hao and Chu, Wang □heng to lead four thousand troops to overrun Huai West.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan marched into Guangling and sent his general Quetu Xiaobiao with three thousand men to overrun Hao and Chu, and Wang □heng with four thousand to sweep Huai West.

sentences.zh: 李峘辟北固為兵場，插木以塞江口。

translations.literal: Li Kuan cleared Beigu as a drill ground and drove stakes to block the river mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Li Kuan cleared Beigu for a drill ground and drove stakes into the river mouth to block it.

sentences.zh: 展軍於白沙，設疑兵於瓜洲，多張火、鼓，若將趣北固者，如是累日。

translations.literal: Zhan encamped at Baisha, set decoy troops at Guazhou, displayed many fires and drums as if about to hasten toward Beigu—thus for days on end.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan encamped at Baisha and posted decoy forces at Guazhou, setting out fires and drums as though he meant to strike Beigu. This went on for days.

sentences.zh: 峘悉銳兵守京口以待之。

translations.literal: Kuan mustered all elite troops to guard Jingkou and await him.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan gathered all his best troops to hold Jingkou and wait for the attack.

sentences.zh: 展乃自上流濟，襲下蜀。

translations.literal: Zhan then crossed from upstream and struck Xia Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan then crossed upstream and fell upon Xia Shu.

sentences.zh: 峘軍聞之，自潰，峘奔宣城。

translations.literal: Kuan's army, hearing this, collapsed of itself; Kuan fled to Xuancheng.
translations.idiomatic: When Kuan's army heard of it, it broke and fled of its own accord, and Kuan ran to Xuancheng.

sentences.zh: 甲午，展陷潤州。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Zhan took Run Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Zhan captured Run Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 升州軍士萬五千人謀應展，攻金陵城，不克而遁。

translations.literal: Sheng Prefecture soldiers, fifteen thousand, plotted to respond to Zhan, attacked Jinling city, did not take it and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen thousand soldiers of Sheng Prefecture plotted to join Zhan, attacked Jinling city, failed to take it, and dispersed.

sentences.zh: 侯令儀懼，以後事授兵馬使姜昌群，棄城走。

translations.literal: Hou Lingyi was afraid, entrusted later affairs to army-and-horse commissioner Jiang Changqun, abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Lingyi, in fear, entrusted all remaining affairs to army-and-horse commissioner Jiang Changqun and abandoned the city in flight.

sentences.zh: 昌群遣其將宗犀詣展降。

translations.literal: Changqun sent his general Zong Xi to go to Zhan and surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Changqun sent his general Zong Xi to Zhan to surrender.

sentences.zh: 丙申，展陷升州，以宗犀為潤州司馬、丹楊軍使；

translations.literal: On bingshen, Zhan took Sheng Prefecture, made Zong Xi Run Prefecture aide and Danyang army commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Zhan captured Sheng Prefecture and appointed Zong Xi aide of Run Prefecture and commissioner of the Danyang army;

sentences.zh: 使昌群領升州，以從子伯瑛佐之。

translations.literal: made Changqun command Sheng Prefecture, with nephew Boying to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: he put Changqun in charge of Sheng Prefecture, with his nephew Boying to assist him.

sentences.zh: 李光弼攻懷州，百餘日，乃拔之，生擒安太清。

translations.literal: Li Guangbi attacked Huai Prefecture; after more than a hundred days he took it and captured An Taiqing alive.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangbi besieged Huai Prefecture for more than a hundred days before capturing it and taking An Taiqing alive.

sentences.zh: 史思明遣其將田承嗣將兵五千徇淮西，王同芝將兵三千人徇陳，許敬江將二千人徇兗鄆，恭薛鄂將五千人徇曹州。

translations.literal: Shi Siming sent his generals Tian Chengsi to lead five thousand troops to subdue Huai West, Wang Tongzhi to lead three thousand troops to subdue Chen, Xu Jingjiang to lead two thousand troops to subdue Yan and Yun, and Gong Xue'e to lead five thousand troops to subdue Cao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Siming sent his generals Tian Chengsi with five thousand men to overrun Huai West, Wang Tongzhi with three thousand to overrun Chen, Xu Jingjiang with two thousand to overrun Yan and Yun, and Gong Xue'e with five thousand to overrun Cao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月，丙子，党項寇美原、華原、同官，大掠而去。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingzi, Tangut raided Meiyuan, Huayuan, and Tongguan, plundered greatly and departed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingzi, Tangut forces raided Meiyuan, Huayuan, and Tongguan, looted heavily, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 賊帥郭惲等引諸羌、胡敗秦隴防禦使韋倫，殺監軍使。

translations.literal: Bandit chieftain Guo Yun and others led various Qiang and Hu to defeat Qin-Long defense commissioner Wei Lun and killed the army supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit chieftain Guo Yun and others led Qiang and Hu allies to defeat Qin-Long defense commissioner Wei Lun and kill the army supervisor.

sentences.zh: 兗鄆節度使能元皓擊史思明兵，破之。

translations.literal: Yan and Yun military commissioner Neng Yuanhao struck Shi Siming's troops and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Yan and Yun military commissioner Neng Yuanhao attacked Shi Siming's army and routed it.

sentences.zh: 峘之去潤州也，副使李藏用謂峘曰：「處人尊位，食人重祿，臨難而逃之，非忠也；

translations.literal: When Kuan was leaving Run Prefecture, deputy commissioner Li Zangyong said to Kuan: "To occupy men's honored rank, eat men's heavy salary, and flee when danger comes—this is not loyalty;
translations.idiomatic: As Kuan was leaving Run Prefecture, deputy commissioner Li Zangyong said to him, "To hold an honored post, draw a heavy salary, and flee when danger comes is not loyalty;

sentences.zh: 以數十州之兵食，三江、五湖之險固，不發一矢而棄之，非勇也。

translations.literal: with troops and provisions of several tens of prefectures, the steep defenses of the Three Rivers and Five Lakes, to release not one arrow yet abandon them—this is not courage.
translations.idiomatic: to command the armies and stores of dozens of prefectures, with the natural defenses of the Three Rivers and Five Lakes, and abandon them without loosing a single arrow is not courage.

sentences.zh: 失忠與勇，何以事尹！

translations.literal: Losing loyalty and courage—how can one serve the ruler!
translations.idiomatic: Without loyalty and courage, how can one serve the sovereign!

sentences.zh: 藏用請收餘兵，竭力以拒之。」

translations.literal: Zangyong asks to gather the remaining troops and exert full strength to resist him."
translations.idiomatic: Let me gather the remaining troops and resist with all my strength.

sentences.zh: 峘乃悉以後事授藏用。

translations.literal: Kuan then fully entrusted later affairs to Zangyong.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan then entrusted all remaining affairs to Zangyong.

sentences.zh: 藏用收散卒，得七百人，東至蘇州募壯士，得二千人，立柵以拒劉展。

translations.literal: Zangyong gathered scattered soldiers, obtained seven hundred men, went east to Suzhou to recruit stalwart men, obtained two thousand men, and built palisades to resist Liu Zhan.
translations.idiomatic: Zangyong gathered the scattered troops and mustered seven hundred men. He went east to Suzhou to recruit stalwarts and raised two thousand more, then built palisades to resist Liu Zhan.

sentences.zh: 展遣其將傅子昂、宗犀攻宣州，宣歙節度使鄭炅之棄城走，李峘奔洪州。

translations.literal: Zhan sent his generals Fu Zi'ang and Zong Xi to attack Xuan Prefecture; Xuan-She military commissioner Zheng Jiongzhi abandoned the city and fled; Li Kuan fled to Hong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan sent his generals Fu Zi'ang and Zong Xi to attack Xuan Prefecture. Xuan-She military commissioner Zheng Jiongzhi abandoned the city and fled, and Li Kuan fled to Hong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 李藏用與展將張景超、孫待封戰於郁墅，兵敗，奔杭州。

translations.literal: Li Zangyong with Zhan's generals Zhang Jingchao and Sun Daifeng fought at Yushu; the army was defeated and fled to Hang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zangyong fought Zhan's generals Zhang Jingchao and Sun Daifeng at Yushu, was defeated, and fled to Hang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 景超遂據蘇州，待封進陷湖州。

translations.literal: Jingchao then held Suzhou; Daifeng advanced and took Hu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchao then seized Suzhou, and Daifeng advanced and captured Hu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 展以其將許嶧為潤州刺史，李可封為常州刺史，楊持璧蘇州刺史，待封領湖州事。

translations.literal: Zhan made his general Xu Yi Run Prefecture prefect, Li Kefeng Chang Prefecture prefect, Yang Chibi Suzhou prefect, and Daifeng in charge of Hu Prefecture affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan appointed his general Xu Yi prefect of Run, Li Kefeng prefect of Chang, Yang Chibi prefect of Suzhou, and put Daifeng in charge of Hu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 景超進逼杭州，藏用使其將溫晃屯餘杭。

translations.literal: Jingchao advanced pressing Hang Prefecture; Zangyong made his general Wen Huang encamp at Yuhang.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchao pressed toward Hang Prefecture, and Zangyong posted his general Wen Huang at Yuhang.

sentences.zh: 展以李晃為泗州刺史，宗犀為宣州刺史。

translations.literal: Zhan made Li Huang Si Prefecture prefect and Zong Xi Xuan Prefecture prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan appointed Li Huang prefect of Si and Zong Xi prefect of Xuan.

sentences.zh: 傅子昂屯南陵，將下江州，徇江西。

translations.literal: Fu Zi'ang encamped at Nanling, about to descend on Jiang Prefecture and subdue Jiang West.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Zi'ang encamped at Nanling, preparing to move downriver on Jiang Prefecture and overrun Jiang West.

sentences.zh: 於是屈突孝摽陷濠、楚州，王□恆陷舒、和、滁、廬等州，所向無不摧靡，聚兵萬人，騎三千，橫行江、淮間。

translations.literal: Thereupon Quetu Xiaobiao took Hao and Chu Prefecture; Wang □heng took Shu, He, Chu, and Lu and other prefectures; wherever they went nothing failed to be crushed; they gathered ten thousand troops and three thousand cavalry and ranged across Jiang and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Quetu Xiaobiao captured Hao and Chu prefectures, and Wang □heng took Shu, He, Chu, Lu, and others. Wherever they turned, resistance collapsed. They gathered ten thousand infantry and three thousand cavalry and ranged freely across Jiang and Huai.

sentences.zh: 壽州刺史崔昭發兵拒之，由是□恆不得西，止屯廬州。

translations.literal: Shou Prefecture prefect Cui Zhao raised troops to resist them; thereby □heng could not go west and only encamped at Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shou Prefecture prefect Cui Zhao raised troops to resist them, so □heng could not push west and halted at Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 初，上命平廬都知兵馬使田神功將所部精兵五千屯任城；

translations.literal: Earlier the emperor ordered Pinglu overall army-and-horse commissioner Tian Shen'gong to lead his picked elite troops, five thousand, to encamp at Rencheng;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the emperor had ordered Pinglu overall army-and-horse commissioner Tian Shen'gong to lead five thousand picked troops of his command to encamp at Rencheng;

sentences.zh: 鄧景山既敗，與刑延恩奏乞敕神功救淮南，未報。

translations.literal: Deng Jingshan, having been defeated, with Xing Yan'en memorialized begging an edict for Shen'gong to rescue Huai South—no reply.
translations.idiomatic: After Deng Jingshan's defeat, he and Xing Yan'en memorialized begging that Shen'gong be ordered to rescue Huai South, but received no answer.

sentences.zh: 景山遣人趣之，且許以淮南金帛子女為賂，神功及所部皆喜，悉眾南下，及彭城，敕神功討展。

translations.literal: Jingshan sent a man to urge him on, and moreover promised Huai South gold, silks, and women as bribes; Shen'gong and his command all rejoiced, mustered the whole host southward, and reaching Pengcheng, an edict ordered Shen'gong to suppress Zhan.
translations.idiomatic: Jingshan sent envoys to hurry him along and promised the gold, silks, and women of Huai South as reward. Shen'gong and his men were delighted and marched south in full force. At Pengcheng an edict arrived ordering Shen'gong to suppress Zhan.

sentences.zh: 展聞之，始有懼色，自廣陵將兵八千拒之，選精兵二千度淮，擊神功於都梁山，展敗，走至天長，以五百騎據橋拒戰，又敗，展獨與一騎亡渡江。

translations.literal: Zhan, hearing this, first showed fear; from Guangling he led eight thousand troops to resist, selected two thousand elite troops to cross the Huai, struck Shen'gong at Duliang Mountain; Zhan was defeated, fled to Tianchang, with five hundred cavalry held the bridge to resist battle, was defeated again; Zhan alone with one mounted man fled across the river.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhan heard this, fear showed on his face for the first time. He led eight thousand men from Guangling to resist, chose two thousand elite troops to cross the Huai, and attacked Shen'gong at Duliang Mountain. Zhan was defeated and fled to Tianchang, where with five hundred cavalry he held a bridge and fought again, but was beaten once more. Zhan alone, with a single rider, escaped across the river.

sentences.zh: 神功入廣陵及楚州，大掠，殺商胡以千數，城中地穿掘略遍。

translations.literal: Shen'gong entered Guangling and Chu Prefecture, plundered greatly, killed merchant Hu by the thousands; within the cities the ground was dug and tunneled nearly everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Shen'gong entered Guangling and Chu Prefecture and looted on a vast scale, killing merchant Hu by the thousands. Within the cities the ground was dug and tunneled almost everywhere.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吐蕃陷廓州。」

translations.literal: This year, Tibet took Kuo Prefecture.”
translations.idiomatic: That year the Tibetans captured Kuo Prefecture.”
